observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa unbranded offer, natutukoy ang produkto, promosyon, lugar/kausap at insentibo; naihihiwalay ang polisiya, humihinto at idinudulog ang factual na detalye sa namamahala.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In an unbranded offer, identifies product, promotion, place/audience and inducement; distinguishes policy topics, pauses and routes factual details to the supervisor.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Tumatanggap, nagpapaskil o namimigay, nag-aapruba nang mag-isa, o hindi tinitingnan ang saklaw at detalye.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Accepts, displays or distributes, approves independently, or fails to check scope and details.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Natutukoy ang apat na detalye at tamang koordinasyon nang walang prompt; malinaw ang hangganan ng BHW.
levels.kaya_na_en: Identifies all four details and correct coordination without prompting; clearly respects the BHW role boundary.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Nakikilala ang concern ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa saklaw, kausap o unang pagdulog.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Recognizes the concern but needs prompts about scope, audience or the first coordination step.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Tumatanggap o nag-aapruba nang mag-isa, o pinapantay ang lahat ng alok nang walang pagsusuri.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Accepts or approves independently, or treats all offers as identical without checking.
